name: Aomi
tagline: Tokyo in 33 minutes and Toranomon in 33 minutes. Served by 1 line.
summary: The station is in Koto City, served by Yurikamome. Journey times to the main business districts are 37 minutes to Otemachi, 48 minutes to Shinjuku, 45 minutes to Shibuya and 37 minutes to Shinagawa. The station stands 1.3 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 11.0 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 1.3 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 0.5 m to 11.5 m, a difference of 11.0 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 1 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 3 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is フジテレビ湾岸スタジオビル診療所, about 9 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 癌研有明病院, about 27 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
congestion: Yurikamome runs at 92% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 汐留→竹芝, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.
